title: Entangled: A Unified Metric for Evaluating Selective Forgetting in Generative Models

contributions.purpose: 为生成模型选择性遗忘提供统一评测指标
contributions.mechanism: Entangled 指标:对前景/背景区域的相似度 S 与统计一致性 C 做加权调和平均,支持配对(Entangled-D)与非配对(Entangled-S)两种评测
contributions.evaluation: 本文框架 Entangled-D 0.8680 / Entangled-S 0.8119,均高于 CLIPAway(0.7920/0.7266)
contributions.domain: 生成模型选择性遗忘 / 图像反学习评测
contributions.source_quote: Entangled Metric. We introduce Entangled, a unified metric that quantifies both forgetting success and background consistency for generative models.

contributions.purpose: 提供可控遗忘评测的轻量基准数据集
contributions.mechanism: training-free 分层编辑流水线(SAM 分割+CLIP 打分+GPT 验证抽前景,LaMa+Stable Diffusion 重建背景)构建 ForgetMe 数据集,含原图/前景/背景/掩码四层
contributions.evaluation: 覆盖 ImageNet/Stanford Dogs/CUB-200-2011 及 1 万张合成猫图,前景移除成功率 >90%
contributions.source_quote: Training-Free Benchmark. We construct a lightweight dataset using layered image editing to simulate controlled forgetting scenarios.

contributions.purpose: 验证指标与框架优于现有方法
contributions.mechanism: 在猫/鸟等类别上与 CLIPAway、LoRA+I2I、LoRA+inpaint 做定量对比,并做 LoRA 缩放因子 alpha 消融
contributions.evaluation: 本文框架 FID 58.88(CLIPAway 68.47)、CLIP Dist 0.9456(高约 13.6%)、CLIP@1 0.8096;消融显示 alpha>=0.9 才能有效反学习
contributions.source_quote: Empirical Validation. We evaluate Entangled on cat and bird categories, demonstrating its effectiveness compared to existing metrics and baselines.
